Sprinklr與Metric Sherpa於10月28日公布Show Your Work調查。在536名所屬機構有AI應用常態運作的受訪者中，92%稱表現達到或超出預期，27%稱能用紀錄或報表精確量化結果。

整體樣本為807名美國行銷、服務及客戶體驗從業者；標題分析採用536人的正式使用子樣本。

網上調查於9月8日至23日進行；結果屬自報，未經獨立稽核。

報告提出成果、責任人、基準、比較及覆核五項量度要素。

數字反映美國特定從業者自報，不代表全部企業；27%不等同其餘AI應用無效，亦不構成產品成效證明。
article.detail_en:
Sprinklr and Metric Sherpa released Show Your Work on October 28. Among 536 respondents whose organizations had AI in regular live use, 92% said it met or exceeded expectations and 27% said they could quantify outcomes precisely using records or reports.

The total sample was 807 U.S. marketing, service and CX practitioners; headline analysis used the 536-person live-use subgroup.

The online survey ran September 8–23; results are self-reported and were not independently audited.

The report proposes five measurement disciplines: outcome, owner, baseline, comparison and review.

Satisfaction and quantified evidence are different signals. Teams can define baselines, owners and comparison methods before treating positive perceptions as demonstrated ROI.

For one AI use case, document the baseline, business metric, data source and review date before deciding whether to scale or change it.

These are self-reports from selected U.S. practitioners, not all businesses. The 27% finding does not establish that other AI deployments failed or prove product efficacy.
